questions.question_text: What do we say to our teacher in the morning?
What did the monkeys take from the cap seller?
Which of these is a healthy food?
How many colours are there in Anandi's rainbow?
What type of clothes do we wear in the winter season?
Choose the correct plural form of 'Apple':
Choose the correct article: 'I saw ___ elephant.'
Name two colours you can see in Anandi's rainbow. (Max 10 words)
questions.answer: I can see red and yellow in the rainbow.

questions.question_text: Name two animals you can find on a farm. (Max 10 words)
questions.answer: We can find a cow and a goat.

questions.question_text: Where did the cap seller fall asleep? (Max 10 words)
questions.answer: The cap seller fell asleep under a big tree.

questions.question_text: What do you like to do in the rainy season? (Max 15 words)
questions.answer: I like to jump in puddles and use my blue umbrella.

questions.question_text: Write one good habit we should follow before we eat food. (Max 15 words)
questions.answer: We should always wash our hands with soap before eating food.

sections.section_name: Section C - Grammar & Matching (Fill in the Blanks)

questions.question_text: Fill in the blanks with correct pronouns (He / She / It / They): 1. Ram is a boy. ___ is tall. 2. The apple is red. ___ is sweet. 3. Sita and Gita are playing. ___ are happy. 4. My mother is kind. ___ cooks tasty food.
Fill in the blanks with correct Position Words (In / On / Under): 1. The book is ___ the table. 2. The fish swims ___ the water. 3. The dog is sleeping ___ the chair.
Imagine you are the Cap Seller. What would you say to the monkeys to get your caps back? Write 2 simple sentences.
questions.answer: Please give me my caps back, little monkeys. If you give them back, I will give you some sweet bananas.

questions.question_text: Describe your favourite food using two describing words (adjectives). Write 2 simple sentences about why you like it.
questions.answer: My favourite food is a big, round pizza. I like it because it is hot and very yummy.
